title: The Ship That Wouldn't Open
production: All sound effects generated with ElevenLabs

lines.text: There she is. Class-nine extraterrestrial spacecraft. Perkins, we're getting inside.
How?
Historically? At the cost of the professor's assistant.
Let's not overcomplicate this. Perkins, pull the handle.
Oh, sure, I can just...
AAAAGH!
Interesting. A high-voltage bioelectric deterrent. Quite sophisticated.
There's a lightning bolt painted on the door.
Yes, thank you.
Fine. We'll use mechanical leverage. Perkins, the crowbar.
Got it. One... two... THREE!
IS THAT BAD?!
Just a proximity alarm.
It's broadcasting our coordinates to eleven hostile civilizations. Twelve now.
Let's introduce some heat. Perkins, fire up the plasma torch.
Finally, something I'm qualified to...
Ah! The hull anticipates thermal attacks three seconds before they occur.
Fascinating. It anticipated Perkins being on fire.
Perkins, pour the liquid nitrogen onto the hull.
Right, sir. Pouring it on now...
Ah! It splashed back! My boots are frozen!
Excellent. You cannot run away now.
There's a maintenance port beneath the engine. Twist that valve.
It's opening! Oh. Oh, that's... green.
Professor, the goo is eating my shoe!
Stop exaggerating.
You'll need to throw those shoes away. They look like they're infected.
Aha! An interstellar communications dial. This could be our way in.
Or an excellent way to summon something.
Professor? Is it talking to us?
Regrettably.
Unit-7, translate.
The mothership says this vessel is overdue for inspection.
By how much?
Four thousand years.
Tell them we're authorized technicians.
I told them we're contagious.
WHY?
They've disconnected.
Wait. The engines! Their startup cycle might release the door locks.
Are the engines firing up? Look out!
MY EYEBROWS! MY EYEBROWS ARE GONE!
Interesting. The propulsion system is entirely functional.
Unlike Perkins' face.
We'll bypass the lock with a quantum phase inverter.
You brought one?
I brought Perkins.
Why won't it open? Electricity, heat, leverage, quantum manipulation... we've tried everything.
You haven't tried leaving.
Wait. That symbol! It's not an intergalactic warning. It's a ceremonial offering glyph!
Like... candy?
Exactly!
TRICK OR TREAT!
Trick or treat!
